{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Remove duplicate patient IDs, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
total_count = len(trial_df)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_count

print(f"Fraction of patients with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")

# Return the fraction
fraction_severe"}
